items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I think the song I remember having heard Lois Step sing on a record was 'Sometimes I Feel Like a Motherless Child'.

ctx.x: Did Lois Deppe sing in a similar kind of style to Orlando?

No, I think the song I remember having heard Lois Step sing on a record was 'Sometimes I Feel Like a Motherless Child'. In fact, that's the only vocal I heard because the other side of the other record was strictly instrumental and he didn't sing on it. But I remember his vocal as 'Sometimes I Feel Like A Motherless Child'. And I think that in the production "Great Day" he sang "Hallelujah".
